messages:
zoe: Heads-up team  Aurora Health finished onboarding via AWS Marketplace and selected Redwood Dedicated for inference. Live this morning. :tada:

rafa: Amazing! any quick numbers from smoke tests?

zoe: Smoke: 25% end-to-end latency reduction on chart-search queries, and nearly 2x throughput for bulk export jobs using our batching config + prefix cache. They went with reserved Dedicated capacity (region: us-west-2).

meera: Can we get a short 2-sentence customer quote + a one-paragraph technical note for the external announcement? I can draft the blog post.

carl: Ops notes: they required BYOK KMS + 90-day audit retention. Ticket INF-4599 filed. Also set up VPC peering and mutual TLS.

ops-bot: AWS Marketplace listing active: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/AURORA-EXAMPLE  status: ACTIVE.

marketing: Marketing will draft the marketplace spotlight and social. Please provide a single ROI stat and one line about security to include.

zoe: ROI stat: projected 25% latency reduction and 18% token-cost savings after batching + model quantization. Security line: Dedicated with BYOK (KMS) and audit logs enabled.

rafa: Sales: please add Aurora Health to reference list (Ref ID: REF-AUR-47). Also capture renewal play in CRM.

sales-bot: Reference added: REF-AUR-47. Renewal playbook tag created.

meera: Draft tech snippet for the engineering blog:

```\nredwood.create_pool(\n  name=\"aurora-dedicated-pool\",\n  region=\"us-west-2\",\n  reserved_instances=6,\n  model=\"clinic-qa-4b\",\n  quant_variant=\"int8-v3\",\n  cache_prefixing=true\n)\n```

carl: Design request DGN-856 created for a small infra diagram. Also scheduled a 30-min quote call with Auroras Head of Platform tomorrow at 2pm PT. Invite sent.

meera: Legal consent form queued; will share final quote once signed.

ops-bot: Observability ticket SRE-2359 created to add per-route latency dashboard + 14-day retention for the Aurora routes.

zoe: Congrats team  let's get the case study live next week. :rocket:
